I sent Ilse the answer in our direct message: Amendment No. 1 takes Quarrendon Freight Lines to **185 seats**.

- **Source:** On 20 Aug 2025, Dana posted 180 seats in #north-team, the day after the amendment was signed. Two minutes later she corrected it to 185 and said she was updating the Q-Freight sheet. Ilse is a member of #north-team.
- **Not checked against the amendment:** I couldn't find the amendment itself in the shared files, so Dana's correction is my only source. I told Ilse that June has the signed copy if she wants to check it.
- **Sharing:** A seat count isn't a finance figure, so Ilse can have it as North team lead without anyone's approval.
